# Cynoteck Technology Solutions

> > Cynoteck delivers enterprise CRM development, AI-powered solutions, and IT services specializing in Salesforce, Dynamics 365, and Microsoft Power Platform implementations.

Cynoteck is a Microsoft Solutions Partner and Salesforce consulting firm offering end-to-end digital transformation services. The company provides strategy, implementation, customization, integration, and 24/7 support across leading CRM and low-code platforms for enterprises and SMBs.

## Key Topics

- Salesforce CRM
- Dynamics 365
- Power Platform
- Power BI
- CRM Implementation
- Business Integration
- Data Analytics
- Digital Transformation
- Low-Code Development
- Cloud Solutions
- Microsoft Solutions Partner
- Salesforce Partner
- AI-Powered CRM
- Data Migration
- Omnichannel Support

## Salesforce Services

- [Salesforce Development Services](https://www.cynoteck.com/Salesforce-Development-Services): Salesforce development and customization services by certified Cynoteck consultants.
- [Salesforce Consulting Services](https://www.cynoteck.com/salesforce-consulting-services): Salesforce consulting: strategic implementation, optimization, and user adoption services.
- [Salesforce Implementation Services](https://www.cynoteck.com/salesforce-implementation-services): End-to-end Salesforce implementation: planning, customization, training, post-launch support.
- [Salesforce Customization Services](https://www.cynoteck.com/salesforce-customization-services): Salesforce customization: configuration, migration, and 24/7 support services.
- [Salesforce Integration Services](https://www.cynoteck.com/salesforce-integration-services): Salesforce integration: ERP, CTI, email, Google Apps with MuleSoft and APIs.
- [Salesforce Administration Services](https://www.cynoteck.com/salesforce-administration-services): Salesforce administration: automation, security, data management, dashboards, 24/7 support.
- [Salesforce Support and Maintenance Services](https://www.cynoteck.com/salesforce-support-and-maintenance-services): Salesforce support and maintenance: 24/7 monitoring, bug fixes, updates, expert assistance.

- [Dynamics 365 for Customer Service](https://www.cynoteck.com/dynamics-365-for-customer-service): Dynamics 365 Customer Service: omnichannel support, AI insights, agent productivity.
- [Dynamics 365 for Field Service](https://www.cynoteck.com/dynamics-365-for-field-service): Dynamics 365 Field Service: AI scheduling, mobile support, IoT insights, inventory.
- [Dynamics 365 for Project Service Automation](https://www.cynoteck.com/dynamics-365-for-project-service-automation): Dynamics 365 Project Operations: scheduling, cost tracking, resource planning, analytics.
- [Dynamics 365 Business Central](https://www.cynoteck.com/dynamics-365-business-central): Dynamics 365 Business Central: ERP consulting, implementation, migration for SMBs.
- [Dynamics 365 Customer Insights](https://www.cynoteck.com/microsoft-dynamics-365-cutomer-insight): Dynamics 365 Customer Insights: unified customer data, real-time tracking, AI insights.
